scope: Theorem 10.4 (Single-profile angular bound) of the manuscript “The Falconer distance conjecture in all dimensions” (preprints/The-Falconer-distance-conjecture-in-all-dimensions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 073 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 98a7e721547308b9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 56. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let H [c,N] 0 (c, N) be a recursive angular state of nonterminal width, as in Definition 9.2. Fix its initial derivative budget B and its common numerical angular bounds Qj, independently of N, as in Definition 7.1. Then H [c,N] 0 (c, N) ≤ R2Ac−V([c,N])+Cd(κ+σ/κ)+o(1) . (10.4) This bound holds uniformly over its two occupied cells, including two copies of the same cell, and over its admissible bounded spatial multipliers and symbols with these fixed bounds. The o(1) term may depend on B and the Qj.
